questions.question: Which part of the photoelectric experiment helps to determine Planck’s constant?

answers.b: The plot of stopping potential vs. frequency
answers.d: The color of the filter used

questions.question: What is the work function of a metal?

answers.a: The energy needed to create an electric field
answers.b: The minimum energy required to release an electron from the surface
answers.c: The energy required to accelerate an electron
answers.d: The total energy emitted as light

questions.question: Why do photoelectrons have different kinetic energies?

answers.a: Due to the varying distance of electrons from the nucleus
answers.c: Because of energy absorbed from light with different frequencies

questions.question: What does the intercept on the y-axis represent in a plot of stopping potential vs. frequency?
How is the energy of a photon calculated in this experiment?

answers.a: By multiplying the stopping potential by the charge of an electron
answers.b: By dividing the frequency by the wavelength
answers.c: By taking the square of the frequency
answers.d: By subtracting the work function from the total energy
